description: Opens one agent, by its id, with everything about it in one call: what it does, its rhythm, what its switch does and where it stands, its cards waiting, and from its own records its last run in full, everything it found (the Creator agent: every creator by name with who fits; the SEO agent: each buyer question and how each assistant answered; the Reddit agent: each of its checks), what waits for the owner, and what it needs before it can run. An agent with nothing behind it says so; an id that does not work on this business is refused with the ids that do.

id.description: the agent's id, as agents_read and input.app.agents give it

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: agent_open
